name: Hide Top Bar (WhiteHades)
description:
Hide the GNOME top bar until you move the pointer to the top edge. It stays visible while you use the panel or its menus, including over fullscreen apps.

This fork addresses hover flicker and cropped settings on GNOME 50. It keeps GNOME rendering the bar over apps that fill the display, adds a short cancellable hide delay, and reverses interrupted slides from their current position. The native Activities hot corner works during panel animations. Settings wrap and scroll, and tests cover pointer timing, menus, monitor changes, and cleanup.

Based on Hide Top Bar by Thomas Vogt, Mathieu Lutfy, Philip Witte, and contributors. Independently maintained by WhiteHades for GNOME 50.
